build.label: Core Duel — Room to Grow · rules 0.33.0-core.3-room

orchard.name: The Orchard
orchard.pitch: Spend the harvest or grow the canopy. Bee and Wind pollinate for Fruit or healing; Seeds become Oaks; Graft two trees into an Espalier that keeps producing.
orchard.plan: Open on Seed or Sapling and a blocker. Before combat, decide: attack with two trees, or Graft them into one Espalier (3/5 Reach) that frees a place and makes Fruit or Growth every upkeep. Abundance turns grown trees into a strong attack. Feast heals and stands a defender up.

furnace.name: The Furnace
furnace.pitch: Keep the firebird or spend the fuel. Kindle or Tinder lights your Naphtha for a flare on the two oldest enemies; Calcine leaves Ash; Firebird and Ash become a Phoenix.
furnace.plan: Open with a cheap flyer or Ember and a way to ignite. Naphtha is a visible threat: fire it while the rival's two oldest Things are worth hitting. If Rain wets it, Drought dries the field. Calcine an exhausted attacker into Ash, then fuse Firebird + Ash into a 4/4 Phoenix that is reborn once.

forge.name: The Clay Court
forge.pitch: Decide what the metal is for. Copper can climb to Silver, become a Hammer that finishes the wounded, or an engraved Signet that seals protection and stamps Writ. Clay + Word make a 4/5 Golem.
forge.plan: Wall up with Clay, Boulder and Guard. Pivot on Copper: keep its attack, Transmute toward Silver and Gold, Shape a Hammer, or Shape a Signet. Clay can shield a survivor. Golem has Reach; send it forward to spill damage through a destroyed blocker.

frozenDecks.note: Earlier deck lists (V33) are kept in the game code but are not the current decks.

fire.ember.name: Ember
fire.ember.text: Non-living, Hot, Body. Can Burn and Scorch. Eligible Energy and Steam ingredient.

fire.salamander.name: Salamander
fire.salamander.text: Living Beast, Body, Hot, Flammable. Bite. After dealing positive combat damage to a flammable Thing, Ignite it if it survives.

fire.firebird.name: Firebird
fire.firebird.text: Living Beast, Bird, Winged, Flying, Swift, Hot, Body. After dealing positive combat damage to a flammable Thing, Ignite it if it survives. Phoenix ingredient.

fire.smith.name: Smith
fire.smith.text: Living Person, Body, Flammable. Crush and Burn capabilities.

fire.torch.name: Torch
fire.torch.text: At your upkeep, deal 1 damage to rival.

fire.burn.name: Burn
fire.burn.text: Action. Your Burn-capable Thing Ignites a dry Flammable Thing — the rival's or your own.

fire.scorch.name: Scorch
fire.scorch.text: Hot subject. Remote: deal 2 damage to enemy Thing or rival; cannot be blocked.

fire.kindle.name: Kindle
fire.kindle.text: Response. Choose: Ignite one of your dry Flammable Things (e.g. Naphtha); or a friendly Thing gets +1 strike this turn and ignites the flammable Things it damages in combat.

fire.fire.name: Fire
fire.fire.text: At your upkeep, Ignite oldest eligible visible enemy Thing which is Flammable, damaged and not already Burning. Reagent for Fireborn recipes.

fire.calcine.name: Calcine
fire.calcine.text: Main. Additional cost: sacrifice a Thing of yours. Deal 3 to a visible enemy Thing or the rival. If you chose Ash at declaration and have room and none, make an Ash.

fire.bellows.name: Bellows
fire.bellows.text: At your upkeep, gain 1 additional breath.

fire.naphtha.name: Naphtha
fire.naphtha.text: Non-living Liquid, Flammable. The first time it is Ignited: destroy it and deal 3 at once to the two oldest visible enemy Things (all, if fewer). No damage to the rival. Wet stops it igniting.

fire.wildfire.name: Wildfire
fire.wildfire.text: Main. One or two visible enemy Things: 1 damage each, or 3 to each that is Burning when it resolves. Never the rival.

fire.drought.name: Drought
fire.drought.text: Weather (2 turns). When called, every Thing stops being Wet. At each upkeep the active player's Things dry. Your first Ignite of an enemy Thing each turn also deals 1 damage.

fire.firebrand.name: Firebrand
fire.firebrand.text: Attach to friendly Thing. Grants Hot; +1 damage on first unblocked combat hit against rival each own turn. Lawful.

air.owl.name: Owl
air.owl.text: Living Beast, Bird, Winged, Flying, Sharp, Body, Flammable. On arrival optionally reveal enemy Concealed Thing.

air.hawk.name: Hawk
air.hawk.text: Living Beast, Bird, Winged, Flying, Sharp, Body, Flammable.

air.swallow.name: Swallow
air.swallow.text: Living Beast, Bird, Winged, Flying, Swift, Body, Flammable.

air.crow.name: Crow
air.crow.text: Living Beast, Bird, Winged, Flying, Body, Flammable. First time a Living Thing dies during each own turn, gain 1 Might counter.

air.wind.name: Wind
air.wind.text: Non-living, Flying (wingless), Body. Blow capability. Winged recipe reagent. Folio: wind carrier (can pollinate Hazel, even when Wet).

air.magpie.name: Magpie
air.magpie.text: Living Beast, Bird, Winged, Flying, Body, Flammable. First time it deals combat damage to rival each own turn, gain 1 spark subject to additional-income cap.

air.herald.name: Herald
air.herald.text: Living Person, Body, Flammable. On arrival inspect top 2 deck cards and select 1 into hand.

air.air.name: Air
air.air.text: At your upkeep inspect and reorder top 2 words of your deck.

air.orrery.name: Orrery
air.orrery.text: Your Things cannot take damage directly from Sky effects. Other Weather effects still apply.

air.winged.name: Winged
air.winged.text: Quality. Attach to a friendly Thing that does not already fly: it gains Winged, Flying and Blow.

air.quick.name: Quick
air.quick.text: Attach to friendly Thing. Grants Quick.

air.resonant.name: Resonant
air.resonant.text: Attach to Thing. First time it takes damage each turn, deal 1 damage to every other Thing sharing base word. Resonance damage cannot trigger further Resonance.

air.blow.name: Blow
air.blow.text: Blow-capable subject. Choose distinct ready friendly Thing with Hot, Liquid or Toxic; exhaust payload as additional cost. Choose qualifying property and up to 2 eligible enemy Things. Apply Burning, Wet or 1 poison dose respectively. Both subject and payload must remain present.

air.storm.name: Storm
air.storm.text: Each upkeep deal 1 damage to active player's oldest non-Flying Thing, or 2 if Wet.

air.squall.name: Squall
air.squall.text: Exhaust 1–3 friendly Flying Things eligible to act as additional cost. Deal 2 non-combat damage to rival per Thing exhausted, one batch.

air.birds.name: Birds
air.birds.text: Catalogue: inspect top 3 deck words; select Bird Thing if present. Category = intrinsic Bird.

air.gasp.name: Gasp
air.gasp.text: Gain 2 additional breath, subject to generation cap.

air.gust.name: Gust
air.gust.text: Push: return enemy non-Heavy Thing with current strike <= 2.

earth.boulder.name: Boulder
earth.boulder.text: Non-living Stone, Heavy, Body, Guard, Bedrock.

earth.stone.name: Stone
earth.stone.text: Non-living Stone, Heavy, Body. Stonebound reagent.

earth.lead.name: Lead
earth.lead.text: Non-living Metal, Heavy, Body. Metal ladder lowest form.

earth.tin.name: Tin
earth.tin.text: Non-living Metal, Body. Intermediate metal form.

earth.copper.name: Copper
earth.copper.text: Metal. Transmute into Silver; or Shape into a Hammer or a Signet. One metal change per turn.

earth.silver.name: Silver
earth.silver.text: Metal, Sacred. Transmute into Gold; or Shape into a Signet.

earth.gold.name: Gold
earth.gold.text: Transformed-only. Metal, Body, Incorruptible. At your upkeep gain 1 extra breath.

earth.clay.name: Clay
earth.clay.text: Clay. Main, 1 breath, sacrifice Clay: the next damage to another friendly Thing before your next Renew is reduced by up to 3. Clay + Word make a Golem in the Vessel.

earth.transmute.name: Transmute
earth.transmute.text: Advance friendly Thing one permitted metal ladder edge; choose branch at declaration.

earth.crucible.name: Crucible
earth.crucible.text: Ground. Your first fusion each turn costs 1 less (min 2). Temper: Main, 1 breath, exhaust a mature ready damaged Metal: heal 2 from it, once per turn.

earth.earth.name: Earth
earth.earth.text: At your upkeep give 1 Growth counter to oldest eligible friendly Plant.

earth.salt.name: Salt
earth.salt.text: Enemy Haunt actions cannot target your Things.

earth.amber.name: Amber
earth.amber.text: Non-living material. First time another friendly original Living Thing dies while Amber remains, recover its original card if possible, then sacrifice Amber. Once per physical Amber card per duel.

earth.temper.name: Temper
earth.temper.text: Attach to friendly Metal Thing. +2 maximum stand, immune to Rust and Brittle. Remove existing Brittle condition/attachment on resolution.

earth.leaden.name: Leaden
earth.leaden.text: Attach to Thing. Heavy, +1 maximum stand, loses Flying. Lawful.

earth.fixed.name: Fixed
earth.fixed.text: Attach to friendly Thing; Fixed while attached.

earth.desert.name: Desert
earth.desert.text: While present, wing-dependent flight suppressed. Does not ground wingless atmospheric Things/spirits.

earth.winter.name: Winter
earth.winter.text: On arrival freeze all Wet Things and remove their Wet. At each upkeep freeze active player's oldest Wet Thing, then remove Wet.

earth.metals.name: Metals
earth.metals.text: Catalogue: inspect top 3 words; select Metal Thing if present. Category = intrinsic Metal.

earth.iron.name: Iron
earth.iron.text: Metal, Heavy. Shape into a Hammer.

earth.flint.name: Flint
earth.flint.text: Non-living Stone, Sharp, Body. Burn capability.

earth.guard.name: Guard
earth.guard.text: Main. A friendly Thing gains Reach and +2 stand until your next Renew. When it expires, damage beyond its stand destroys it.

earth.crush.name: Crush
earth.crush.text: Action. Your Heavy or Crush-capable Thing hits a reachable visible enemy Thing with +2 strike. Damage beyond what destroys it hits the rival once. Never the rival or a Ground.

earth.cut.name: Cut
earth.cut.text: Sharp or Cut-capable subject. Combat: strike +1. Alternatively remove Bound from reachable friendly Thing instead of damage.

life.wolf.name: Wolf
life.wolf.text: Living Beast, Body, Flammable. Bite. +1 strike while controlling another Beast.

life.bramble.name: Bramble
life.bramble.text: Living Plant, Body, Reach, Flammable. Bind, Sting. After dealing positive retaliation damage to surviving Living attacker, apply Bound.

life.aloe.name: Aloe
life.aloe.text: Living Plant, Herb. Mend. At upkeep heal 1 damage from oldest damaged friendly Thing.

life.apothecary.name: Apothecary
life.apothecary.text: Living Person, Body, Flammable. Mend. Main, 1 breath, exhaust: heal friendly Thing 2 or remove 1 poison dose from it.

life.bite.name: Bite
life.bite.text: Bite-capable subject. Combat against Living Thing or rival: strike +1. No damage to Sacred/non-living interceptor.

life.mend.name: Mend
life.mend.text: Mend-capable subject. Heal damaged friendly Thing 3.

life.seed.name: Seed
life.seed.text: Living Plant, Flammable. At upkeep gain 1 age; at 2 transform into Sapling.

life.sapling.name: Sapling
life.sapling.text: Living Plant. At your upkeep gains 1 age; at age 2 becomes Willow (with Water Ground) or Oak. Can Bind. A Graft rootstock.

life.oak.name: Oak
life.oak.text: Living Plant, Tree, Body, Heavy, Flammable. World Tree ingredient.

life.willow.name: Willow
life.willow.text: Living Plant, Tree. Can Bind. Main, 1 breath, exhaust: heal up to 2 marked damage on a friendly Thing.

life.grow.name: Grow
life.grow.text: Give friendly Plant 1 Growth counter. If unfinished plant ladder, also advance age by 1 subject to ladder rules.

life.scarab.name: Scarab
life.scarab.text: Living Beast, Insect, Body, Sacred, Recurrent. Ouroboros ingredient.

life.pear.name: Pear
life.pear.text: Living Plant, Tree, Orchard, Flower. Insect-pollinated: your Bee can pollinate it (Fruit, heal 2 life, or heal 2 on a Living Thing).

life.rose.name: Rose
life.rose.text: Living Plant, Flower, Body, Reach, Flammable. Sting. On arrival, if controlling another Flower and no Blossom, create Blossom if space. New collectible word.

life.saffron.name: Saffron
life.saffron.text: Living Plant, Flower, Herb. First time another Flower enters your field each own turn, gain 1 spark subject to additional-income cap.

life.ivy.name: Ivy
life.ivy.text: Living Plant, Body, Reach, Flammable. Bind.

life.graft.name: Graft
life.graft.text: Registered Grafted Plant recipe on two compatible friendly Plants. Counts as Vessel use. Pay catalyst if required. Printed price is entire recipe price before discount.

life.abundance.name: Abundance
life.abundance.text: Main. One or two of your Plants gain 1 Growth each (+1 stand). Each chosen Tree with 2+ Growth then gets +2 strike this turn.

life.spring.name: Spring
life.spring.text: Each upkeep advance age of active player's oldest unfinished plant ladder by 1; heal 1 damage from their oldest damaged Living Thing.

life.harvest.name: Harvest
life.harvest.text: Each upkeep, if active player controls Plant and no Fruit, create Fruit if space.

life.bind.name: Bind
life.bind.text: Response. Your Bramble, Sapling, Willow or Espalier binds a reachable enemy Thing until its controller ends their turn. A Bound attacker deals no damage.

life.tame.name: Tame
life.tame.text: Take control of enemy original Beast Thing, current strike <= 2, not Named, empty destination slot required.

life.thorny.name: Thorny
life.thorny.text: Attach to friendly Thing. Reach, Sting. Lawful.

life.feral.name: Feral
life.feral.text: Attach to friendly Thing. +1 strike, Bite. Lawful.

life.beasts.name: Beasts
life.beasts.text: Catalogue: inspect top 3 deck words; select Beast Thing if present. Category = intrinsic Beast.

life.plants.name: Plants
life.plants.text: Catalogue: inspect top 3 deck words; select Plant Thing if present. Category = intrinsic Plant.

water.otter.name: Otter
water.otter.text: Living Beast, Sea-born, Swift, Body, Flammable. Bite.

water.ice.name: Ice
water.ice.text: Non-living, Heavy, Guard. After receiving combat damage, make attacker Wet if still in play. Once per turn.

water.seep.name: Seep
water.seep.text: Liquid or Sea-born subject. Remote: deal 2 damage to enemy Thing or rival; cannot be blocked.

water.tonic.name: Tonic
water.tonic.text: Potion. Heal yourself 3 life, remove 1 poison dose from yourself.

water.water.name: Water
water.water.text: At your upkeep choose friendly Thing, make Wet and heal 1 marked damage. Aquatic reagent.

water.flask.name: Flask
water.flask.text: First Potion successfully played each own turn heals you for 1 additional life. Homunculus ingredient.

water.vitriol.name: Vitriol
water.vitriol.text: Non-living Liquid, Body, Dissolve. Main, 2 breath, exhaust: deal 3 damage to Metal or Stone Thing. Alkahest ingredient.

water.quicksilver.name: Quicksilver
water.quicksilver.text: Non-living Liquid, Metal, Incorruptible. Alkahest ingredient.

water.wash.name: Wash
water.wash.text: Liquid or Sea-born subject. Push: return enemy non-Heavy Thing with maximum stand <= 4.

water.memory.name: Memory
water.memory.text: Recover one of your Action or Spell cards printed cost <= 2, excluding Memory. Seal this Memory on successful resolution.

water.rain.name: Rain
water.rain.text: On arrival make every Thing Wet. At each upkeep heal 1 damage from active player's oldest damaged Thing.

water.tide.name: Tide
water.tide.text: Push: return up to 2 enemy non-Heavy Things, each maximum stand <= 4. At least one target required.

water.dissolve.name: Dissolve
water.dissolve.text: Dissolve-capable subject. Remote: deal 3 damage to Metal, Stone or Liquid target Thing or Ground; otherwise 2 damage to target Thing.

water.dew.name: Dew
water.dew.text: Response. Choose one: Wet a visible Thing (any side); or heal up to 2 marked damage on a friendly Living Thing; or remove 1 poison from you or a friendly Living Thing.

water.drench.name: Drench
water.drench.text: Liquid or Sea-born subject. Remote: make target Thing Wet. If Hot, deal 1 damage to it.

water.frozen.name: Frozen
water.frozen.text: Apply Frozen to a Wet Thing.

water.thaw.name: Thaw
water.thaw.text: Remove Frozen from target Thing. If friendly, heal 1 damage.

water.sleep.name: Sleep
water.sleep.text: Apply Asleep to Living Beast or Person.

rot.rat.name: Rat
rot.rat.text: Living Beast, Body, Flammable. On death apply 1 poison dose to eligible visible enemy Living Thing chosen by controller.

rot.adder.name: Adder
rot.adder.text: Living Beast, Serpent, Body, Venomous. Bite. Ouroboros ingredient.

rot.spider.name: Spider
rot.spider.text: Living Beast, Body, Venomous. Bite, Bind.

rot.leech.name: Leech
rot.leech.text: Living Beast, Sea-born, Body. Bite. First positive combat damage to Living Thing or rival each own turn, heal controller 1 life.

rot.yew.name: Yew
rot.yew.text: Living Plant, Tree, Toxic, Body, Flammable. On death apply 1 poison dose to eligible visible enemy Living Thing.

rot.wormwood.name: Wormwood
rot.wormwood.text: Living Plant, Herb, Toxic. At upkeep remove 1 poison dose from yourself or chosen friendly Thing.

rot.poison.name: Poison
rot.poison.text: Toxic subject. Remote: apply 2 poison doses to enemy Living Thing or rival, normal cap 3.

rot.barrow.name: Barrow
rot.barrow.text: First time an original friendly Living Thing dies during each own turn, create Carrion if space.

rot.spore.name: Spore
rot.spore.text: Living Fungus, Flying (wingless). On death apply 1 poison dose to eligible visible enemy Living Thing.

rot.toadstool.name: Toadstool
rot.toadstool.text: Living Fungus, Toxic. When sacrificed, apply 1 poison dose to eligible visible enemy Living Thing.

rot.ghost.name: Ghost
rot.ghost.text: Non-living Spirit, Dark, Flying (wingless), Body. Haunt.

rot.shadow.name: Shadow
rot.shadow.text: Non-living Spirit, Dark, Body. Enters Concealed. Haunt.

rot.decay.name: Decay
rot.decay.text: Sacrifice friendly Thing as additional cost. Deal 3 damage to enemy Thing, 4 if sacrificed Thing was Carrion.

rot.rust.name: Rust
rot.rust.text: Target enemy non-Incorruptible Metal Thing. Deal 3 damage and regress one permitted metal-ladder edge if possible, simultaneous batch.

rot.wither.name: Wither
rot.wither.text: Enemy Living Thing: if Plant, remove up to 2 Growth counters and deal 2 damage; otherwise deal 1 damage.

rot.haunt.name: Haunt
rot.haunt.text: Spirit/Dark subject. Remote: return enemy non-Sacred Thing with maximum stand <= 4. Not Push. Salt prevents targeting.

rot.exhume.name: Exhume
rot.exhume.text: Revive one of your original Thing cards printed cost <= 2. Seal Exhume on successful resolution. New collectible word.

rot.miasma.name: Miasma
rot.miasma.text: Apply 1 poison dose simultaneously to every enemy Living Thing and rival.

rot.night.name: Night
rot.night.text: First original Thing each player deploys during their own turn enters Concealed. Concealment persists after Night leaves Sky.

rot.venomous.name: Venomous
rot.venomous.text: Attach to Thing; grants Venomous. Lawful.

rot.debt.name: Debt
rot.debt.text: Each of affected rival's next 2 upkeeps they spend 1 spark or lose 1 life. If no spark, lose life. Retire after second tick.

rot.feeble.name: Feeble
rot.feeble.text: Attach to enemy Thing; −1 strike while attached.

word.word.name: Word
word.word.text: Non-living, Body. First other successful hand-card sentence each own turn grants 1 Might counter. Golem/Homunculus ingredient.

word.familiar.name: Familiar
word.familiar.text: Living Beast, Body, Flammable. First fusion each own turn costs 1 less, minimum 2. Does not stack with Crucible.

word.separate.name: Separate
word.separate.text: Separate eligible friendly non-Final Made Thing per §7, sufficient slots required; consumes fusion allowance.

word.scribe.name: Scribe
word.scribe.text: Living Person, Body, Speaker, Flammable. On arrival inspect/reorder top 2 deck cards.

word.bard.name: Bard
word.bard.text: Living Person, Body, Speaker, Flammable. First successful Voiced spell each own turn: draw 1.

word.hermit.name: Hermit
word.hermit.text: Living Person, Body, Speaker, Flammable. Enters Concealed.

word.grimoire.name: Grimoire
word.grimoire.text: On arrival draw 1. At upkeep inspect/reorder top 2 deck words.

word.ink.name: Ink
word.ink.text: At upkeep gain 1 extra spark subject to additional-income cap.

word.omen.name: Omen
word.omen.text: Inspect top 3 deck words, select 1 to hand, others to bottom in chosen order.

word.name.name: Name
word.name.text: Give friendly Thing Named. No automatic Golem in this candidate.

word.dispel.name: Dispel
word.dispel.text: Retire one standing Quality attachment, Burden, Weather or Law. Alternatively reveal enemy Concealed Thing.

word.echo.name: Echo
word.echo.text: Next successful Action card this turn returns to hand instead of being spent, if room. Does not repeat action automatically. Seal Echo on successful resolution.

word.silence.name: Silence
word.silence.text: Reveal rival's current hand. Choose 1 Action or Spell there cost <= 3 and discard it. If none qualifies only reveal.

word.scream.name: Scream
word.scream.text: Voice. Deal 2 damage to rival; remove Asleep from all Things.

word.reckoning.name: Reckoning
word.reckoning.text: Destroy all enemy Things maximum stand <= 2 simultaneously.

word.be.name: Be
word.be.text: Only compound Law, Category + Be + Lawful Quality. Pay all three printed costs. Shared Law per §5.9.

word.awaken.name: Awaken
word.awaken.text: Main. A friendly non-living Thing gains Body and 1 Might (+1 strike) while in play. A Body only gains the Might.

word.summon.name: Summon
word.summon.text: Take control of enemy original Thing printed cost <= 2, not Named, requires empty Field slot.

word.loan.name: Loan
word.loan.text: Gain 2 additional breath subject to cap; reduce next turn's base breath by 1.

word.gnosis.name: Gnosis
word.gnosis.text: Draw 2 words, reveal all enemy Concealed Things.

word.protect.name: Protect
word.protect.text: Give friendly Thing Ward if not already Ward.

word.doubt.name: Doubt
word.doubt.text: Response: cancel pending rival Spell, Quality, Weather, Burden or Law total printed card cost <= 3. Main alternative: reveal enemy Concealed Thing.

token.ash.name: Ash
token.ash.text: Token. Ash. Can block. Firebird + Ash make a Phoenix in the Vessel.

token.fruit.name: Fruit
token.fruit.text: Token. Food. Main, 1 breath, sacrifice: heal 2 life, or heal 2 marked damage on a friendly Living Thing, or remove 1 poison from one. Also pays for Feast.

token.carrion.name: Carrion
token.carrion.text: Token. Organic. Decay deals 4 when Carrion is its sacrifice.

made.energy.name: Energy
made.energy.text: Fire/Air. Non-living. At your upkeep gain 1 extra breath (within the +2 limit).

made.steam.name: Steam
made.steam.text: Fire/Water. Body, Seep. Makes Things it damages in combat Wet. Disperses at its controller's second upkeep.

made.golem.name: Golem
made.golem.text: Earth/Word. Clay, Stone, Body. Heavy, Guard.

made.homunculus.name: Homunculus
made.homunculus.text: Water/Word. Living Person, Speaker, Body. On formation inspect the top 3 cards of your deck and take a Spell.

made.phoenix.name: Phoenix
made.phoenix.text: Made: Firebird + Ash. Flying. Once per duel, if damage would destroy it, it survives instead: damage cleared, exhausted.

made.alkahest.name: Alkahest
made.alkahest.text: Water. Liquid, Final. Main, 1 breath, sacrifice Alkahest: destroy an enemy Thing or damageable Ground.

made.ouroboros.name: Ouroboros
made.ouroboros.text: Rot/Life. Living Beast, Serpent, Body. Venomous, Bite, Final. Its controller's first Ouroboros death recovers one released ingredient to hand.

made.life.name: Life
made.life.text: Life/Earth/Water. Living. At your upkeep heal 1 life.

made.world_tree.name: World Tree
made.world_tree.text: Life/Earth/Water. Living Plant, Tree, Body. Guard, Final. At your upkeep heal 2 life and give 1 Growth to your oldest other Living Thing.

made.philosophers_stone.name: Philosopher's Stone
made.philosophers_stone.text: Earth/Word with elemental lineage. Stone, Metal, Body. Final. At your upkeep choose: 1 extra breath or draw 1.

life.bee.name: Bee
life.bee.text: Living Beast, Insect, Winged, Flying. Pollinate: Main, 1 breath, exhaust this mature ready Bee to pollinate your Pear or Apple — choose: make 1 Fruit (room and none), or heal 2 life, or heal 2 marked damage on a friendly Living Thing. One pollination per turn (shared with Wind). Wet grounds it.

life.hazel.name: Hazel
life.hazel.text: Living Plant, Tree, Orchard, Flower. Wind-pollinated: Main, 1 breath, exhaust your mature ready Wind to pollinate it — make 1 Fruit (room and none), or heal 2 life, or heal 2 marked damage on a friendly Living Thing. One pollination per turn.

life.feast.name: Feast
life.feast.text: Main. Heal up to 2 marked damage on one or two of your Living Things. You may also sacrifice your Fruit: then ready one exhausted Thing of yours for defence only until your next Renew (it can block, not attack, act, carry or fuse).

earth.shape.name: Shape
earth.shape.text: Main. Work your Copper or Silver into a Setting: same card, same damage, compatible attachments stay. Not if Fixed, not if it would die, at most one metal change per turn.

earth.garnet.name: Garnet
earth.garnet.text: Non-living Stone, Jewel, settable. Can block. Set it into a Setting in the Vessel to make a Signet.

word.writ.name: Writ
word.writ.text: Main. Exhaust a ready rival Person or Speaker. Or endorse it by exhausting your mature ready Signet: exhaust up to two ready rival Things. Each target is rechecked; Ward stops it on a single target. Doubt can counter it.

rot.mould.name: Mould
rot.mould.text: Living Fungus, Decomposer. Main, 1 breath, exhaust: seal a Plant card of yours that died (destroyed or sacrificed) from your Grave; another friendly Plant gains 1 Growth and 1 age. A discarded Plant or a released ingredient cannot pay.

earth.setting.name: Setting
earth.setting.text: Transformed only (from Copper or Silver). Metal, Socket. No Body. Can block. Remembers its original card: bounced, it returns as that word. Set + Garnet in the Vessel = Signet.

made.signet.name: Signet
made.signet.text: Made: Setting + Garnet (Set recipe, 2 breath). Metal, Artefact, Instrument. Main, 1 breath, exhaust: give a friendly original Thing Named. Or exhaust it to endorse Writ. Separate restores the Setting and the Garnet.

life.apple.name: Apple
life.apple.text: Living Plant, Tree, Orchard, Flower. When Apple arrives, if you control another Flower and no Fruit, make 1 Fruit (room permitting). Your Bee can pollinate it.

fire.tinder.name: Tinder
fire.tinder.text: Non-living, Flammable. Main, 1 breath, sacrifice Tinder: Ignite a visible dry Flammable Thing other than itself. If it was yours and caught, make an Ash (room and none). Usable the turn it arrives.

earth.hammer.name: Hammer
earth.hammer.text: Metal, Body, Tool. Can Crush. Main, 1 breath, exhaust: deal 2 to a visible damaged enemy Thing or to the enemy Ground.

life.graft3.name: Graft
life.graft3.text: Main. Join your Pear or Apple with your Sapling or another fruit tree in the Vessel: they become an Espalier (2 breath, no catalyst). Uses your Vessel this turn.

earth.shape3.name: Shape
earth.shape3.text: Main. Change your Copper or Iron into a Hammer, or your Copper or Silver into a Signet. Keeps its place and damage. One metal change per turn.

word.writ3.name: Writ
word.writ3.text: Main. Exhaust a ready visible enemy Thing with strike 2 or less. Or stamp it by exhausting your mature ready Signet: exhaust one or two ready enemy Things of any strike.

earth.signet3.name: Signet
earth.signet3.text: Shaped only (Copper or Silver). Metal, Instrument. Main, 1 breath, exhaust: give another friendly Thing Ward. Or exhaust it to stamp Writ. Cannot Ward itself.

made.espalier.name: Espalier
made.espalier.text: Made: fruit tree + Sapling or another fruit tree (Graft). Living Plant, Tree. Reach, can Bind. At your upkeep: make a Fruit (none and room), else +1 Growth to another friendly Plant.

made.golem3.name: Golem
made.golem3.text: Made: Clay + Word. Heavy, Guard, Reach. When its attack destroys its blocker, the excess damage hits the rival once.

checks.claim: Iron can be Shaped into a Signet
checks.reason: Iron cannot be shaped into a Signet
Hazel is wind-pollinated; Bee carries pollen by insect

checks.claim: Oak can be a Graft rootstock (Pear + Oak → Espalier)
checks.reason: No Graft is offered: Oak is not a listed rootstock (Graft joins Pear or Apple with Sapling or another fruit tree)

checks.claim: Kindle can Ignite a Wet Naphtha
checks.reason: Naphtha is Wet — dry it first (Drought)

checks.claim: Copper can be Transmuted straight to Gold
checks.reason: Transmute offers only earth.silver from Copper (one ladder step at a time)
Seal is offered on 1 other friendly Thing(s), never on the Signet itself
